title: TaxLineDetail

TaxRateRef.description: Product: QBW Description: Reference to a TaxRate. For all editions of QuickBooks, for TaxLineDetail line types that apply a specific TaxRate to the preceding line of the transaction, this is a reference to that TaxRate. For a TaxLineDetail in a TxnTaxDetail, where the TxnTaxCodeRef is set, the TaxRate referenced here MUST also be one of the rates in the referenced tax code's rate list (either t...

PercentBased.description: Product: ALL Description: True if the sales tax is expressed as a percentage; false if expressed as a number amount.

TaxPercent.description: Product: ALL Description: Numerical expression of the sales tax percent. For example, use "8.5" not "0.085".

NetAmountTaxable.description: Product: QBO Description: This is taxable amount on the total of the applicable tax rates If TaxRate is applicable on two lines, the taxableamount represents total of the two lines for which this rate is applied This is different from the Line.Amount which represent the final tax amount after the tax has been applied

TaxInclusiveAmount.description: Product: QBO Description: This is the amount which also includes tax.

OverrideDeltaAmount.description: Product: QBO Description: This holds the difference between the actual tax and overridden amount supplied by the user.

ServiceDate.description: Product: ALL Description: Date when the service is performed.

TaxLineDetailEx.description: Product: ALL Description: Internal use only: extension place holder for TaxLine.

description: Product: ALL Description: Tax detail for a transaction line.
